## PR 284

**Customer model, merge rules, and the single view by phone number**

**বাংলায়:** কাস্টমার ফোন নম্বর দিয়ে একজন মানুষ: তাঁর সব প্রোফাইল আর নম্বর এক জায়গায়, বিক্রি শুধু ডেলিভারি হওয়া; একই মানুষের দুইটা প্রোফাইল একজন মানুষ দেখে একসাথে করেন, কিছু মোছে না, আবার আলাদা করা যায়; পুরো নম্বর শুধু অনুমতিতে, প্রতিটা দেখা লগে থাকে

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-29
  - Build status row: the customer model, the merge rules and the single view by phone (new package `@extas/customers`; migration `0047_customer_merge` additive: `Customer.mergedIntoId` / `mergedAt` with an index, `CustomerMerge` with `MERGED` / `NOT_SAME`, the rules that matched, the note, who, the Idempotency-Key and the undo; registry v60 `registry-customers.ts`): a merge only points the joining profile at the one that stays (one level, nothing moves, nothing is deleted), refused when either is erased, archived, already merged or has merged profiles of its own; "not the same person" keeps a pair from being suggested again; a split (or a "not the same" taken back) needs a note and is audited. Suggestions from `customers.merge` {suggest on, signals e-mail · WhatsApp number is the other's phone · name + address · the same identity on an order (all on), 20 a page, note required off}. The single view by phone: every profile and every number of the person, order counts and lifetime value from `@extas/metrics` (`customerKpis`: Sales = delivered only beside Ordered value, CN-022; refusals without the shop's own mistakes), any written form of a number finds him (`customerByPhone`). Phone masked without `customers.phone` (`customers.phoneMask` {first 3, last 3}); every open and every copy or call written to "Who looked at this customer" first (Note 24.1). Permissions `customers.read`, `customers.phone`, `customers.merge`. Customers → To review (`/admin/customers/review`, demo V12.4 CUS-05): the "Same person?" pairs side by side, Merge / Not the same person, the decisions with Split; API under `/api/admin/customers`
  - GitHub pull request #51, 30 Oct
- **What it does (original scope):** Customer model, merge rules, and the single view by phone number
- **Filed under:** [S14 · CRM & customers — PR 284–303](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s14--crm--customers--pr-284303)
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `@extas/customers`, `registry-customers.ts`, `@extas/metrics`
  - Routes: `/admin/customers/review`, `/api/admin/customers`
  - Settings and named keys: `customers.merge`, `customers.phone`, `customers.phoneMask`, `customers.read`
  - Names in the code: `0047_customer_merge`, `Customer.mergedIntoId`, `mergedAt`, `CustomerMerge`, `MERGED`, `NOT_SAME`, `customerKpis`, `customerByPhone`
- **Owning agent:** Doot

## PR 505

**বাংলায়:** মেসেজের লেখা বদলানোর পাতা: প্রতিটা SMS, WhatsApp আর ইমেইল বাংলা-ইংরেজি পাশাপাশি, নমুনা অর্ডারে সাথে সাথে দেখা যায়; কোন ঘটনায় কোন মেসেজ যায়; স্বয়ংক্রিয় উত্তর (ডিফল্ট বন্ধ)

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-30
  - Build status row: notification template editor (Launch row 47, SIM-F-001, SIM-F-025, SIM-F-031): `/admin/messages/templates` (every SMS, WhatsApp and e-mail template, English and Bengali side by side with the live preview on a cash, prepaid and part-paid sample order, where each is used, Save over the version, Reset to default, a missing language added) and `/admin/messages/journey` (which event sends which message); the auto-reply `messages.autoReply` (registry v61, off; once in 24 hours per number, never to a stopped number); permissions `messages.templates.read/write`; default pack `reply.received`
  - GitHub pull request #73, 1 Nov
  - GitHub pull request #57, 30 Oct
  - GitHub pull request #51, 30 Oct
- **What it does (original scope):** **Notification template editor** — every SMS, email and WhatsApp template, the auto-replies, and which event sends which message, all written and changed from the admin
- **Filed under:** [S14 addition (approved 18 Oct)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s14-addition-approved-18-oct)
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **19 Oct** · [Scope added to existing PRs (round 15, no new PR numbers)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-624): **PR 148 / 505 (status notifications + template editor)** — the owner's default send rule: **SMS on order placed, SMS when the shop confirms/processes (courier booked), WhatsApp once when the shop processes — nothing from the shop after that** (the courier's own pickup SMS is the third message). Later-step messages exist as switches, off by default.
  - **19 Oct 11:39** · [Owner answers](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-624): marketing consent = SMS tick on by default, **WhatsApp marketing tick separate and unticked** (PR 148/505)
  - **20 Oct** · [CN-014 (owner: add the 8 best simulation ideas as optional settings; a Bengali guide per admin section)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#build-status): (f) **Day-1 WhatsApp care** (idea 15): the send hour, the text, and the Day-3 review request. Section: Messages. Scope on PR 295, 289 and 505.
  - **23 Oct** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s14-addition-approved-18-oct): **Updated 23 Oct 2026 (CN-014):** Day-1 WhatsApp care (idea 15): the send hour, the text and the Day-3 review request; Messages.
  - **23 Oct** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s14-addition-approved-18-oct): **Updated 23 Oct 2026 (CN-017):** simulation findings SIM-F-001 (paid customers told to pay again on delivery); SIM-F-025 (the Bengali journey is half English); SIM-F-031 (customer copy promises more than the system does) are required acceptance tests of this PR; see `docs/qa/SIMULATION-REPORT.md` §4.
  - **23 Oct** · [Register row](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s14-addition-approved-18-oct): **Updated 23 Oct 2026 (CN-019):** built as one Messages control centre: the order-journey timeline (per step: send or not, channel, template, delay) with caps per order, per channel and in total; the delivery-day message optional; Day-1 care and the Day-3 review on by default; the self-confirm step placeable, "counts as the one WhatsApp" a setting; promotions with audience, frequency cap and quiet hours; every message logged with cost and delivery state.
  - **30 Oct** · [Build status](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#build-status): **Updated 1 Nov (go-live gate SIM-F-031, F-025/F-047; #73):** the thank-you page says "Order placed" until the shop confirms; `Order.lang` (migration `0083`) and `messages.language` "customer" (now the default) send each order's messages in the language it was placed in
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):

  - Routes: `/admin/messages/templates`, `/admin/messages/journey`
  - Settings and named keys: `messages.autoReply`, `reply.received`, `messages.language`
  - Names in the code: `Order.lang`, `0083`
